intent: Provide an opt-in native Go seven-action public image consequence-learning candidate for same public DoorKey contract as Yggdrasil R12. This is NOT a restore or an upgrade of original Wingless R8 learned state, does not reuse its incompatible six-field state and MUST NOT be described as R8 operating at seven actions.

public.mission: use the key to open the door and then get to the goal

mechanism.context: public front [3][5] object type/color/state and agent-local [3][6] carried-object type/color plus heading
mechanism.selected_evidence: one submitted real action 0..6 and actual before/after publicly visible image + original reward and terminal flag; no unselected labels
mechanism.cells: seven independent action-specific observed outcome counters per public feature context; count and positive reward occurrences, no truth table or privileged external planner
mechanism.readout: choose max empirical P(positive reward) only for supported action context with positive observed reward, with ties lower action ID; otherwise abstain (not a secretly chosen action)
mechanism.learn: increment exactly one selected-action native count and positive reward observation; retain all prior action data; cap 4096 samples, 512 contexts, 150k checkpoint bytes

source_roles: Development transport/evidence candidate only. Matched truly selected original FIT transitions must be provided simultaneously to original Yggdrasil R11 learner. R12 objective is explicitly externally fixed as positive_reward for the primary equal-public comparison. Neither model learns a mission parser, and external neutral exploration on abstain must be transparently counted; do not promote an external fallback as a native choice.
guards: reject missing/extra fields and malformed pixel/direction/mission with no native state mutation
reject bad action/reward/terminal and unselected alternative outcomes
strict canonical SHA256 checkpoint with source-only schema and stored counter consistency
no FORGE or CKB-plane controller mutation
